commits.content:
<Window x:Class="SftpSync.UI.MainWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2000/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2000/xaml"
        Title="SftpSync - Assistant de Transfert" Height="350" Width="500"
        Background="#F5F5F5">
    <Grid Margin="20">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
            <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

        <TextBlock Grid.Row="0" Text="Contrôle SftpSync" FontSize="20" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="#333333" Margin="0,0,0,20"/>

        <StackPanel Grid.Row="1" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,20">
            <Button x:Name="BtnTest" Content="1. Tester simu Connexion" Width="180" Height="35" Margin="0,0,10,0" 
                    Background="#007ACC" Foreground="White" FontWeight="Bold" Click="BtnTest_Click"/>
            
            <Button x:Name="BtnStart" Content="2. Lancer la Surveillance" Width="180" Height="35" 
                    Background="#28A745" Foreground="White" FontWeight="Bold" Click="BtnStart_Click"/>
        </StackPanel>

        <GroupBox Grid.Row="2" Header="Journal d'activité en direct" Padding="10">
            <TextBox x:Name="TxtStatus" IsReadOnly="True" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" 
                     TextWrapping="Wrap" Background="White" FontFamily="Consolas"/>
        </GroupBox>
    </Grid>
</Window>
